agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.trigger: almost every task (risk local and above)
changes: effort medium
input is the diff file, changed-file list and task acceptance criteria; read surrounding code only to prove impact, never scan the whole repository
for risky tasks always answer: what happens on two concurrent requests, on a retry, on a crash half-way

agents.name: silent-failure-hunter
changes: effort medium
input is the diff file and changed-file list

agents.name: python-reviewer
changes: fold fastapi-reviewer in as a FastAPI section
every finding must cite a line that was actually read in this run; re-open the file to confirm the line before reporting

agents.name: flutter-reviewer
changes: input is the diff file

agents.name: reliability-reviewer
agents.trigger: retries, queues, locks, background jobs, timeouts in the diff
changes: run only on its trigger

agents.name: security-reviewer
agents.trigger: never automatic: only on a local trust-boundary change listed in the project profile (auth, tenant isolation, secrets, personal data, user-supplied SQL, file import) or on operator request
changes: effort medium (was xhigh)

agents.name: architect
changes: fold code-architect in as a second mode: feature-level design inside existing boundaries

agents.name: product-ux-reviewer
changes: fold a11y-architect in as an accessibility section

agents.name: code-explorer
changes: input is a question and an area; stop when the question is answered

agents.name: functional-test-reviewer
changes: fold pr-test-analyzer in
expected values come only from examples in the spec or an independent formula, never computed in the head
tests are written from the acceptance criteria and the run instructions, not from the diff
never write or edit documentation
run the task's own tests once after the task; run the whole own set once at sprint end only

agents.name: tdd-guide
changes: expected values come only from examples in the spec or an independent formula

agents.name: e2e-runner
changes: effort medium (was high)
one scenario per acceptance criterion
full e2e set once at sprint end only

agents.name: implementation-engineer
changes: maxTurns 60
implement the whole task from its plan; do not write tests or documentation

agents.name: build-error-resolver
changes: fold pytorch-build-resolver in as a PyTorch/CUDA section

agents.name: refactor-cleaner
changes: fold code-simplifier in as a 'simplify the changed code' mode

agents.name: technical-writer
changes: fold doc-updater in
two modes: kickoff documents before the project; update existing documents to match the code at sprint end

agents.name: product-owner
changes: fold business-analyst in: requirements, backlog of sprint tasks with acceptance criteria, definition of done
two planning levels only: sprint and tasks; no stories, epics only as labels

agents.name: ui-designer
changes: effort medium (was high)

skills.name: html-report
changes: the report is built by tools/report.py from the ledger and git; after a commit only the changed section is redrawn

skills.name: agent-evaluation
changes: point to bench/ scripts: seeded-defect cases, answer key, scorer; measure found / severity / tokens

skills.name: functional-testing
changes: expected values only from spec examples or an independent formula

skills.name: git-worktree-ops
changes: a worktree is removed after its branch is merged, after checking running processes and ignored files
